newsitem.title: USA: Sunshine Mine says silver production up.
newsitem.headline: Sunshine Mine says silver production up.

text.p: Sunshine Mining and Refining Co said Wednesday it has produced more silver in the first quarter 1997 than in any quarter since June 1991.
It was the second consecutive quarter in which production set such a record.

"Our production levels in 1997 will be the highest of any year since 1990," said John Simko, chairman and CEO. "Total production for the year should exceed four million ounces and by the third quarter, we should be producing at a rate of around five million ounces per year."
The cash costs of production have been significantly cut and look set to continue to decrease, the company said.
Sunshine said it is well positioned to participate in an expected improvement in silver prices.
